# Architecture: Worker Runtime

The physics worker is optional. The main thread selects worker execution when supported and retains a fallback path when SharedArrayBuffer or worker capability is unavailable.

| Protocol area | Observed evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Initialization | `INIT`, `INIT_COMPLETE` in [src/worker/physics.worker.js](../../../../src/worker/physics.worker.js) |
| Configuration | `CONFIG` and `CONFIG_COMPLETE` synchronize runtime and law state |
| Execution | `TICK` emits completion data and optional offspring |
| Control | `TOGGLE_LAW`, `GET_STATE`, `RESTORE`, and `PING` |
| Capability | `WORKER_READY` reports startup and SharedArrayBuffer support |

The worker protocol must remain compatible with solver arguments and law-state serialization. See [state/law-state.md](../../state/law-state.md).
